Posted 'SE Jabba' dested Jabba (Special Edition); 'Mara Jade, TEH' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Mara's saber' Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'Bossk w/ gun' Bossk With Mortar Gun; 'Iggy w/ gun' IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Dengar w/ gun' Dengar With Blaster Carbine; '4-Lom w/ gun' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Fett w/ gun' Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle.

Posted 'Oota Goota Solo?' dested Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?; 'Sniper/Dark Stike' Sniper & Dark Strike; 'TINT/Oppresive Enforcement' There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement. Resistance (Jabba's Palace) and Secret Plans (Special Edition) are the older Effects, not Reflections III shields.
'Push' left UNKNOWN (shown as posted): What're You Tryin' To Push On Us? is a Light card and no Dark card of that name existed.
